children: Blue Owl Technology Finance entered into a First Amendment to its Loan Financing and Servicing Agreement for Athena Funding III to expand borrowing capacity and refine collateral mechanics. The amendment increases the maximum principal amount from $150 million to $250 million and modifies the borrowing base test conditions. Deutsche Bank serves as facility agent, with State Street as collateral agent and custodian, alongside other lenders. The move is expected to enhance liquidity and flexibility for the company's technology lending strategy.
: Amendment to loan financing and servicing agreement for a secured credit facility
: Deutsche Bank, New York Branch; State Street Bank and Trust; and other lenders
: Increase borrowing capacity and optimize collateral terms
